playbooks.title: Playbooks
playbooks.toolbar.modeWhy: Simple hides command lines and ARNs behind a collapsed section; Technical shows them inline. Your choice is remembered.
playbooks.toolbar.newWhy: Write a new plan, or duplicate the one you have open. Built-in plans can only be duplicated — they live in code.
playbooks.list.broken: This file has problems and cannot be run.
playbooks.list.empty.title: No playbooks yet
playbooks.list.empty.hint: Playbooks live in ~/.awog/playbooks (shared) and <project>/.awog/playbooks (per project). Drop a .md file with frontmatter there, then press Reload.
playbooks.source.builtinWhy: Built-in playbooks ship with AWOG. They cannot be edited or deleted — copy one into a folder to make your own version.
playbooks.detail.error.title: Could not open this playbook
playbooks.detail.error.hint: The file may have been edited or removed outside the app. Press Reload to read the list again.
playbooks.detail.none.title: Pick a playbook on the left
playbooks.detail.none.hint: Open one to see the three-row diagram: step → service touched → blast radius.
playbooks.detail.issues: This playbook has {n} problem(s). Fix the file, then press Reload — until it is clean, submitting for approval is blocked.
playbooks.action.submitBlocked: {n} write steps have no rollback step, so this cannot be submitted. Add a step with verb “rollback” first.
playbooks.variables.title: Playbook variables
playbooks.variables.required: Required — fill these in before checking or running.
playbooks.confirm.consequence: The playbook runs an infrastructure command — this is not read-only.
playbooks.confirm.approveAsk: Approve “{name}” — the plan becomes runnable and the approval is written to the audit log.
playbooks.diagram.title: Step → service → blast radius
playbooks.diagram.warn.destructive: Destroy command — this cannot be undone.
playbooks.diagram.warn.noRollback: The playbook has no rollback step.
playbooks.diagram.impact.hint: The blast radius is inferred from the real architecture graph, not from memory.
playbooks.diagram.impact.buildHint: Each build is a few read commands on the pinned account, so it waits for a click.
playbooks.diagram.impact.none: No blast radius could be inferred for this step from the current graph.
playbooks.diagram.impact.noRoots: The graph has no roots to build from yet.
playbooks.diagram.impact.unavailable.hin: The blast radius can only be inferred from the architecture graph. Open the Graph tab on the Infrastructure page to build it, then come back and press Infer blast radius.
playbooks.steps.title: Steps
playbooks.steps.empty: This playbook has no steps yet.
playbooks.run.title: Run
playbooks.run.none: No run in this session yet. Press Check first to learn which step will fail before anything changes.
playbooks.run.freezeError: could not write the wiki page: {error}
playbooks.run.historyNone: No records yet — the first run freezes into an immutable record.
playbooks.toast.preflightOk: Preflight finished — every check step passed.
playbooks.toast.preflightFailed: {n} check steps failed — review the results before running.
playbooks.toast.runFailed: The run stopped at a failed step.
playbooks.toast.rollbackPartial: Rollback stopped at a failed step — the run is NOT fully reverted.
playbook.error.argTooLong: A command argument is too long once the variables are filled in.
playbook.error.badDefault: A variable has an unusable default value.
playbook.error.badId: The playbook id has characters that are not allowed.
playbook.error.badJson: The playbook file is not valid JSON/YAML.
playbook.error.badPlaceholder: A command has a malformed {{variable}} placeholder.
playbook.error.badStepId: A step id has characters that are not allowed.
playbook.error.badValue: A variable value has characters that are not allowed, or breaks a placeholder.
playbook.error.badVariableName: A variable name has characters that are not allowed.
playbook.error.builtinReadOnly: Built-in playbooks are read-only: they cannot be edited or deleted. Copy one into a folder to make your own version.
playbook.error.duplicateStepId: Two steps share the same id.
playbook.error.duplicateVariable: Two variables share the same name.
playbook.error.missingRollback: A write step has no paired rollback step, so this playbook cannot be submitted.
playbook.error.missingValue: A required variable was left empty.
playbook.error.notFound: No playbook with that id exists in that location.
playbook.error.nothingToRollback: Nothing ran, so there is nothing to roll back.
playbook.error.preflightFailed: A check step failed — fix it before running.
playbook.error.runNotFound: That run record no longer exists.
playbook.error.stepInFlight: A step of this run is still running.
playbook.error.unknownVariable: A command references a {{variable}} the playbook does not declare.
playbook.error.wrongStatus: This run is not in a state that allows that action.
playbooks.confirm.deleteBody: The file is removed from disk. Past run records are kept — they carry their own snapshot of the plan that was approved.
playbooks.editor.idWhy: The file this plan is saved as. It comes from the name, and never changes once the plan exists — renaming the file would move it.
playbooks.editor.name: Name
playbooks.editor.descriptionPlaceholder: What this plan is for, and when to reach for it.
playbooks.editor.variablesWhy: Filled in at run time and substituted into {{name}} placeholders in the arguments.
playbooks.editor.noVariables: No variables — every argument is written out in full.
playbooks.editor.varRequiredWhy: A required variable left empty blocks the run before any command starts.
playbooks.editor.stepsWhy: Declaration order is the contract: the Nth do step pairs with the Nth rollback step.
playbooks.editor.missingRollback: {n} do steps have no rollback step yet. You can save this draft, but it cannot be submitted for approval until every one of them is paired.
playbooks.editor.addStepWhy.check: A read that must pass before anything is changed.
playbooks.editor.addStepWhy.do: A write. It needs a rollback step to pair with.
playbooks.editor.addStepWhy.verify: A read that confirms the matching do step worked.
playbooks.editor.addStepWhy.rollback: Undoes the matching do step. The plan runs these in reverse.
playbooks.editor.step.idWhy: Appears in the audit log as playbook:<plan>#<step>.
playbooks.editor.step.argsWhy: one per line — never a shell string, so nothing needs quoting
playbooks.editor.step.noteWhy: read by whoever approves the plan
playbooks.editor.step.notePlaceholder: The bucket must not already exist, or the deploy overwrites someone else's site.
playbooks.editor.err.name: Give the plan a name.
playbooks.editor.err.id: The name produces no usable file name. Type one with letters or digits in it.
playbooks.editor.err.project: Pick the project this plan belongs to.
playbooks.editor.err.noStep: A plan needs at least one step.
playbooks.editor.err.stepId: Step id “{id}” has characters that are not allowed.
playbooks.editor.err.varName: Variable name “{name}” has characters that are not allowed.
